case.summary: Case CASE-009 (Card SC-03009-K955): The case was triggered by a real-time risk score of 0.84 on transaction 4012190 ($874.54) [EV-849afb06]. Historical analysis showed the card SC-03009-K955 had 4 prior transactions averaging $221.93 [EV-d81e5e7a] and 4 online transactions within 48 hours of the flagged transaction [EV-a455aa8e]. Device fingerprinting revealed the iOS device profile was shared across 17 other cards including SC-09000-K1 through SC-09004-K1 [EV-e43106c2], with fraud-ring analysis confirming 4 fraud-confirmed cards in a ring of 18 [EV-91794754]. The customer reported not making the purchases and retaining physical possession of the card [EV-6513c9e0]. One prior case for this customer was cleared as legitimate [EV-b8626e13]. The investigation concluded with a fraud verdict, $887.73 exposure across four transactions, and an undocumented pattern linked to prior case CC-4326.
